guitar.guitaristsText: Dave Grohl / Chris Shiflett / Pat Smear
guitar.modelsText: Gibson Trini Lopez / Gibson ES-335 / Telecaster
guitar.notes: Dave Grohl's Gibson Trini Lopez/DG-335 signature is well known; entry accurate.

tone.target: big dry modern hard-rock crunch with tight low end
tone.profile: big dry modern hard-rock crunch with tight low end
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing a Boost for initial drive, followed by an AC30 TB amp model paired with a UK Vintage 4x12 cab. Chorus adds width, while the overall tone is shaped for tight rhythm crunch and upper-mid bite.
corrections: center on dry driving riff tone

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and eliminate unwanted noise during heavy riffing.
Provide initial grit and boost the signal for maximum rhythm crunch.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate a slight overdrive/boost effect, mimicking an early drive pedal without adding excessive coloration.

alternatives.reason: If more distinct tube saturation is desired.

blocks.purpose: Provide optional wah accents for rhythmic flair and bite.
Add slight width and movement to the rhythm tone without sounding ambient.
Establish the core thick rhythm crunch and high gain required for Foo Fighters' sound.
blocks.gap: Using a general Distortion model to achieve modern, tight rock saturation rather than specific vintage fuzz or OD tones.

alternatives.reason: If the tone needs more aggressive bite.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British Marshall-style amp tone (AC30) for punch and upper-mid bite.
Provide the necessary British cabinet voicing and punchy low-mids.
Fine-tune the tone by boosting upper-mids for bite and tightening the low end.
Add subtle space and depth without washing out the dry rhythm tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and punch by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive, modern hard rock voicing.

proposals.reason: Enhance low-end punch and upper-mid bite for tight rhythm crunch.
